summary: Replaced manual-test fallback auth from direct Anthropic API usage to Claude CLI subprocess auth (subscription mode), removed resolveClient/createGoalLlmClient/API-key dependency, added robust CLI JSON assistant-text parsing, and updated manual-tests coverage for binary resolution, subprocess args/env/prompt, CLI success/empty results, and subprocess failures. Verified with pnpm vitest run src/goal/manual-tests.test.ts src/goal/agent-executor.test.ts, pnpm lint, and pnpm build.
